newsitem.title: UK: Copper firms in LME evening inter-office trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper firms in LME evening inter-office trade.

text.p: Copper prices continued their late afternoon rally from earlier lows and regained the $2,300 a tonne level.
Traders said that with Comex wiping out opening losses after bouncing off a key support area, sellers on the LME contract backed away quickly, making for very thin trading conditions.

A move above $2,300 triggered a few light stops and at 1800 GMT three months delivery was quoted at $2,307/$2,310 a tonne against $2,285 at the end of the afternoon trading session on the Exchange floor.
Elswhere aluminium steadied up to $1,725/$1,728 after dipping below $1,720 earlier on news that Alcan was to restart 22,000 tonnes a year of idled capacity at its Kitimat, British Columbia, smelter.

The nickel price marked time around $7,250 a tonne after a union official at Falconbridge's strikebound Sudbury, Ontario, mine and smelter said they were exploring whether contract talks can resume later this week.
